records.note: Search Console DNS verification. Must survive any nameserver move.

dns.completeness: Enumerated from public DNS (apex, www, _dmarc; A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT/CAA/NS). Namecheap does not allow zone transfer, so records on other subdomains cannot be seen from outside. Export the record list from the Namecheap dashboard before any nameserver change.
dns.hazard: The MX records are Namecheap Email Forwarding, which only works while Namecheap hosts the DNS. Moving nameservers to Cloudflare breaks inbound mail unless forwarding is recreated (Cloudflare Email Routing, free).
